title: Meditation and Yogic Breathing-driven Modulation of Neurofluid Coupling and Brain Clearance
official: Meditation and Yogic Breathing-driven Modulation of Neurofluid Coupling and Brain Clearance
summary: This study will examine whether meditation and yogic breathing can alter brain fluid movement and waste clearance in healthy adults. It will also evaluate the GLYMPHOMETER, a new external forehead-worn device designed to objectively measure changes in brain fluid movement and exchange during meditation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy adults, 25-60 years old.
* Novice or Advanced as defined above.
* Fluent in English.
* Able to travel to BIDMC site for two days approximately 3-7 days apart.

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of neurological and/or neurodegenerative disorders (e.g., epilepsy, stroke, mild cognitive impairment, dementia)
* History of cardiovascular and respiratory illnesses
* History of major psychiatric disorders (e.g., schizophrenia, bipolar disorder)
* Currently diagnosed mental health issues (e.g., anxiety, depression)
* Current use of psychoactive medications, including medications prescribed for anxiety, depression, or other psychiatric conditions, or current use of stimulants or other medications that may substantially affect central nervous system function or study outcomes.
* Skin ailments, abrasions or contusions, particularly located on the forehead and face
